{"task":"derive_control_dae","difficulty":"easy","control_units":["governor lag","turbine lag","frequency inertia/damping plant","droop feedback 1/R"],"inputs":["Delta_P_ref","Delta_P_L"],"states":["Delta_P_v","Delta_P_m","Delta_Omega"],"outputs":["Delta_Omega"],"differential_equations":["T_g*dDelta_P_v/dt=Delta_P_ref-Delta_Omega/R-Delta_P_v","T_t*dDelta_P_m/dt=Delta_P_v-Delta_P_m","2*H*dDelta_Omega/dt=Delta_P_m-Delta_P_L-D*Delta_Omega"],"algebraic_equations":["Delta_P_g=Delta_P_ref-Delta_Omega/R"],"notes":"Delta_P_ref is the power reference perturbation and Delta_P_L the load disturbance. Delta_P_g is the governor input, Delta_P_v the governor state, Delta_P_m the turbine-power state, and Delta_Omega the frequency output/state. T_g,T_t,H are positive constants, R the nonzero droop parameter and D the constant damping coefficient. The three states have independent initial values."}
